subject: Where a gun's shot starts. The mount tail of BSP_Gun_Fire 00730160 (00730762..00730A0E) that docs/GUN_DISPERSION.md left as 'call shape only': the node pick at gun+3CCh, the weapon class's per-barrel muzzle-offset vector at class+98h and its producer 007325A0, the affine transform that turns the two into a world muzzle point, and the fallback when a class has no muzzle list. Establishes that gun vtable slot 1E0h carries a direction, not an origin, and that the class Height plays no part in firing.

corrections.subject: gun vtable slot 1E0h
corrections.was: slot 1E0h base 006E3DC0 'copies three floats; the unmodified muzzle origin'; the 27h override 006FE160 'offsets the origin ... This is how a salvo mount spreads its barrels.'
corrections.is: slot 1E0h takes and returns a shot DIRECTION. Its `in` is 0072F830's arg3, which BSP_Gun_Fire fills from row 2 of the mount node's world matrix and then perturbs with the dispersion cone. The muzzle position is a different argument (arg1) produced at 00730762..007307FC. 006FE160 spreads the shot cone for sub-type 27h, not the barrels across the hull.
corrections.evidence: Three independent lines. (a) docs/GUN_DISPERSION.md's own frame-A table already calls frame A +2Ch..+34h 'row 2, the direction the shot leaves on', and that is the triple passed as arg3 at 0073083D. (b) 006FE160 passes `in` to BSP_Matrix_BuildLookAt as the look-at target with the eye pinned to the triple zeroed at 006FE192-006FE19E (LEA EDX at 006FE18A), meaningful only for a direction. (c) the ring radius class+0D0h is the Lua key MultiBulletConeAngle (00CFE880, read at 00732B17, stored at 00732B1C) - an angle on a direction, not a length on a position. docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md's 0072C006 argument list binds pos and dir separately and corroborates.
corrections.effect: No arithmetic changes. src/gun_platform_arc.cpp's gun_ring_muzzle_origin_006fe160 computes the right thing under a wrong name; 006FE160's own ledger evidence already says 'builds a basis from the input direction'.

corrections.subject: 006FDD70's divisor
corrections.evidence: 006FDD83 MOV EAX,0x2AAAAAAB; 006FDD88 IMUL ECX; 006FDD8A SAR EDX,0x1. The 0x2AAAAAAB magic with a one-bit post-shift is division by 12; /24 needs SAR EDX,2. 0072AB80 (0072AB9A) and 006FE160 (006FE25D) run the identical sequence on the same two fields, 004181A0's indexing stride is 0Ch (004181D0 LEA EAX,[EDI+EDI*2]), and each element is consumed as a float triple by 004142E0 at 007307D3.
corrections.effect: The torpedo fan divides its spacing by n-1; halving n halves the fan. src/gun_dispersion.cpp takes the count as an explicit argument and is unaffected; only a host deriving it from the raw byte span would be.

corrections.subject: the class Height as a muzzle height
corrections.was: muzzle = unit pose translation with y raised by the class Height
corrections.is: Height is the unit class's hull height at class+0A8h, consumed by ship motion (draft, keel) and as a half-extent by the hit slab test. No routine on the firing path reads it. The native muzzle is TransformAffinePoint(class->muzzleOffsets[gun+44Ch], mountNode->worldMatrix), falling back to the node's own translation when the class has no offsets.
corrections.evidence: The whole mount tail 00730762..007307FC and its fallback 00730899..007308F8 were read; the only class field either touches is the muzzle-offset vector at class+98h. 00864D90 does raise a point by [target+538h]+0A8h, but that is the AIM point, not the muzzle. include/bsp/ship_motion.hpp comments class+A8h as hull_height; src/game_hosts_gunnery.cpp:1394 uses it as hull_height*0.5f in the slab test.
corrections.effect: src/game_hosts_gunnery.cpp:1095 is a placeholder with no native counterpart. It raises every muzzle by a whole hull height and gives every gun on a unit the same origin, which is what zeroes h = aim.y - muzzle.y and makes the recovered arc 00955630 indistinguishable from the asin(gR/v^2)/2 pre-estimate. This file is not owned by this packet and was not edited.
